viz_reviews.summary: The page renders STAR as four labelled columns read left to right with the relation names (sets up, motivates, produces) in the gaps and the PAR variant as a strip spanning Situation and Task, which is exactly the framework's shape. Facts-only leaves a coherent stated chain with the unattributed outcomes visibly loose; derived-on adds the implied objectives (Task, the idea-bearing slot, made prominent by the 1.2-size diamond and its own column), the PAR compression and the low-confidence attribution question, and grounding links land on the right facts. Metrics are clean at default view for both examples (0 overlapping pairs, 0 off-screen, 0 under cards), console is clean on load and on switching, stats lines match graph.json (13/4 nodes, 7/9/8 edges; 20/5, 10/15/14), tab switching updates data and stats both ways, and the panel shows quote plus reference for facts and rationale, confidence bar and supporting quotes for derived nodes (verified on t2, r5, p1 classic and t2, r6 tbpn). Legibility is a 4 rather than 5 because several edges run through label text (vertical chains in the Action and Situation columns, two diagonals through the tbpn Task labels) and a few labels spill past their column border; all remain readable, so nothing blocks.

notes: Research (step 2): STAR = Situation, Task, Action, Result; the behavioural-interview decomposition popularised through DDI's Targeted Selection (1970s), used for interview answers, resume bullets (PAR / CAR variants: Problem or Context, Action, Result) and performance reviews; STARR / STARL add Reflection or Learning. Situation forces the starting conditions and stakes; Task forces the actor's own objective and responsibility and is the slot most often left implicit; Action forces concrete first-person steps; Result forces a measurable outcome attributed to the action. Common misuse: 'we' instead of 'I' (agency blurred), action without result, result without attribution (post hoc), situation that swallows the answer, hypothetical instead of completed events, result that merely restates the action. Provenance plan: situation, action and result are normally facts; task is usually derived from situation plus the actions taken; action->result attribution is a fact edge only when the speaker states it, otherwise a derived 'causes' edge with confidence; competing causes from the situation are derived edges. Idea-bearing slot candidate: task (the need the actor had to meet), to be confirmed after the scout. Scout (step 3): three candidates returned: (1) Windsurf acquired by Cognition, told live by Jeff Wang and Scott Wu, 2025-07-14; (2) Agree.com launch to 20,000 users, Marty Ringlein, 2025-05-07; (3) Shaan Puri buying into Somewhere.com, 2025-02-13. Chose (1): a completed 72-hour event narrated by the actors themselves, an explicitly stated Task (rare; lets the graph show a fact-Task beside a derived-Task), timed Actions, measurable Results with speaker-stated attribution, corpus-central entities (Windsurf, Cognition, Google DeepMind) for the future merge, and an underserved-market reading (labs buying GTM organisations; default employee protections in founder acqui-hires). (2) was a close second: single-actor, first-person, numeric results, but its idea angle is a strategy pattern more than an underserved need. Idea-bearing slot: task. Provenance rule applied to edges in both examples: an edge is fact only when the speaker states the connection (because, so, a stated priority enacted); narrative-sequence links are derived with high confidence (0.7-0.9). Graph (step 4): validate.mjs PASS, 0 errors, 0 warnings. classic 17 nodes (13 fact / 4 derived), tbpn 25 nodes (20 fact / 5 derived). Viz loop (step 6): builder iteration 1 chose plane mode for both examples (four labelled bands Situation/Task/Action/Result plus a Problem (PAR) band spanning the first two, relation words as label-only guides, fixed camera distances 130/158); critic iteration 1: pass, scores demonstrates 5 / provenance 5 / legibility 4 / fidelity 5, no blocking issues. Loop stopped at pass per SPEC 8.4. Critic suggestions 1-3 (stagger vertical chains, raise t1 / lower t4 in tbpn, widen the Action-Result gap) are polish left unapplied; suggestions 4-5 are engine-level (camera fit ignores the note card on first load; derived edges between two fact nodes remain visible with derived hidden) and are for the orchestrator.
